verdict.rationale: Cekura supports background automation via cron jobs for scheduled agent testing/evaluation, GitHub Actions CI/CD triggers, and live drift detection/webhooks that autonomously flag and reproduce issues, indicating real autonomous background operation. However, these are narrowly scoped to voice-agent testing/observability workflows rather than general-purpose autonomous automations, and there's no evidence of broader scheduling flexibility, multi-step autonomous agent chains, or independent hands-on confirmation of these automations running unattended reliably. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of cron and CI/CD automations actually running unattended, evidence of general-purpose (non-testing) automation scope, more detail on autonomous drift-detection-to-fix pipeline reliability.
